name: moai-lang-php
description: PHP 8.4+ best practices, PHPUnit 11, Composer, PSR-12; Laravel 12, Symfony 7.
Tools: Read (read_file), Bash (terminal). Auto-load on demand when keywords detected.
Use for related code discussions/file patterns, SPEC implementation (`/alfred:2-run`), code reviews (including TRUST 5 compliance), and feature design. Integrates `moai-foundation-langs` (language detection), `moai-foundation-trust` (quality gates), `moai-core-code-reviewer`, `moai-essentials-debug`.
Follow language best practices. Use latest stable tool versions. Maintain test coverage ≥85%. Document all public APIs.
Skip quality gates. Use deprecated tools. Ignore security warnings. Mix testing frameworks.
